body: Chief on the parity + placements candidate 46314d4: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — one REQUIRED fix before landing, because it is the point of the bead: V-L2 ancestor resolution is implemented TWICE with different hidden-intermediate rules (Codex visibleAncestorChains, compiler.scala:552-567, truncates at the first horizon-hidden segment; Atlas climb, atlas.scala:633-640, passes through unmarked/hidden intermediates to a marked segment) while ADR :358-360 claims they are the same. Extract one private[view] ancestor-chain helper consumed by both (as FeaturePlanner does for features), pin the hidden-intermediate rule in V-L2 (I choose: truncate at the first horizon-hidden ancestor — a hidden object must not be climbed through), and add the parity law for placements (same selection/horizon → same ViaAncestor target on both compilers). Nits in the same candidate: ADR Atlas v2 paragraph says the values use the Codex grammars; expose an exact-only accessor beside NavigationIndex.annotationsFor (or make placementFor public); one V-L2 sentence that off-horizon vs visible-but-unannotated both read OffProjection with the twin's Horizon line separating them; document on CodexFlow.of that externally built flows cannot yield ViaAncestor. Independent run: view 36/36 JVM+JS, fixtures 99/99, compileAll; ancestry verified against landed main. Repost the SHA + view/fixtures 3-platform evidence; I land.
